summary: Independent artifact audit supports the saved aggregation and bounded interpretation. All 32 slots completed; primary results match for both models, with the retrieved all-records null attributable to candidate omission. No new experiments, API calls, source edits or registered tests were performed.

findings.evidence: Recomputed every observed-summary group counter from progress and the separate rubric; embedded requests match requests.json, all tasks occur exactly once, progress SHA-256 matches, and the two permitted frozen runtime-file hashes match the gate. Each model has 13 tool agreements plus 3 correct nulls per 16 full-catalog primary tasks and 12 tool agreements plus 3 correct nulls plus 1 omitted-tool null per 16 retrieved primary tasks. All eight repeat pairs and all cross-model choices match.
findings.recommendation: Keep primary and repeat denominators separate; these are six author-seen requests with supplied decomposition, not independent held-out tasks or evidence of model superiority.

findings.evidence: For m06/all_records the retrieved candidate list contains assigned_machines, expired_qualification_records and current_qualification_records, but not qualification_records. Both models select null under the one-presented-tool-per-task instruction. The saved category unnecessary_null is relative to the full-catalog rubric, not evidence of a mistaken model choice within its shortlist.
findings.recommendation: Always pair that category with required_tool_missing and describe retrieval omission explicitly; do not call it a model reasoning failure.

findings.evidence: All 32 raw executions and 16 derived checked executions are recorded executed; all 102 individual fixed-query calls are completed on study_rdflib. No plan vetoes are recorded. Query_calls sums raw and derived checked execution, so retrieved totals include paired replay. Reservation bounds sum to USD 3.5458150. Progress records USD 0.251945925 reported and zero unresolved costs; independent invoice/ledger verification is outside the allowed packet. Session is completed and execution gate is closed.
findings.recommendation: Report 32 model calls, 48 execution records and 102 local fixed-query calls as different units. Zero observed vetoes does not demonstrate checker efficacy. Preserve failed/unattempted denominators as zero in this completed campaign without implying general reliability.

findings.evidence: docs/experiments/query-model-selection.md still says prepared, not authorized or executed and that actual parameter acceptance and billing remain untested, whereas permitted progress/session artifacts show completion.
findings.recommendation: Update public campaign status and distinguish recorded provider usage from independent billing verification before publishing outcomes.

findings.evidence: The allowed packet supports no final-answer accuracy, SHACL efficacy, Neptune performance, source-completeness result, or measured 16 GiB resource assessment. Only two runtime file hashes could be independently checked within the permitted artifact list.
findings.recommendation: Keep these claims unverified and retain supplied-decomposition, selected-view and fixed-query limits.
